note: EcoFlow Ocean 2 (RE11) frames from a reporter's diagnostics download of 2026-09-07 (issue #145). No RE11 header sets enc_type, so every payload is plaintext protobuf and no XOR key is needed. The device serial was already replaced by 'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' by the capture sanitizer, in the MQTT topic and in module field 16 alike. The owner's timezone id, which the sanitizer left as 'Europe/XXXXXX', is replaced here by the same-length placeholder 'Fixture/TZone' so the frame length and every other byte stay as the device sent them. Readable ASCII runs of six bytes or more, over every frame below: '(EK9(E', '5@5Hqp', '5@5Hqp"', '5@5Hqp0', '5@5Hqp5', '5@5HqpT', '5@5HqpU', '7HBV7HBr', '?%h-$D', '@%*>\\E', 'AU*RkB]b', "AU/'eB]", 'AU2&iB]', 'AUF/aB]', 'AUKoJB]j', 'B]2LIDe', 'B]?:IDe', 'EC5ffHB=33>B@', 'Fixture/TZone', 'HDey,fBh', 'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX', 'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX(', 'ZE%l-)C-l<[E0', ']/CEDe', ']D9EDej', ']IDehL', ']_\\EDe', 'iC-OhC*'. Everything except the two placeholders is coincidentally-printable float payload, not a string. Selection: every 254/39 frame carrying a per-field extreme of a mapped path, every single-message 254/39 property push, two module bundles, one get_reply bundle, and one frame each of 254/40, 254/42 and 254/44 as negative controls. 'capture_index' is the index in the source capture's raw_capture.frames. Built by a script from the download, never edited by hand.
